1	import * as fs from 'fs'
2	import * as path from 'path'
3	import { chromium, type Page } from 'playwright'
4	import { ListingInput } from '../store/listings'
5	
6	export const FACEBOOK_MARKETPLACE_SOURCE = 'facebook-marketplace'
7	
8	const FACEBOOK_STORAGE_STATE_PATH = path.join(
9	  process.cwd(),
10	  'storage',
11	  'facebook-state.json',
12	)
13	
14	export type ScrapeOptions = {
15	  headless?: boolean
16	  maxListings?: number
17	  listingWaitTimeoutMs?: number
18	  onPageReady?: (page: Page) => Promise<void>
19	}
20	
21	export class ScraperError extends Error {
22	  constructor(message: string, options?: { cause?: unknown }) {
23	    super(message, options)
24	    this.name = 'ScraperError'
25	  }
26	}

28	export type MarketplaceSearchParams = {
29	  query: string
30	  location: string
31	  radius: number
32	  maxPrice?: number | null
33	}
34	
35	export function buildMarketplaceSearchUrl(
36	  params: MarketplaceSearchParams,
37	): string {
38	  const locationSlug = params.location.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '')
39	  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams({
40	    query: params.query,
41	    exact: 'false',
42	    radius: String(params.radius),
43	  })
44	
45	  if (params.maxPrice) {
46	    searchParams.set('maxPrice', String(params.maxPrice))
47	  }
48	
49	  return `https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/${locationSlug}/search/?${searchParams.toString()}`
50	}
51	
52	// TODO: Validate that scraped listing locations fall within the requested radius.
53	
54	function parseListingText(text: string): {
55	  title: string | null
56	  price: string | null
57	  location: string | null
58	} {
59	  const lines = text
60	    .split('\n')
61	    .map((line) => line.trim())
62	    .filter(Boolean)
63	
64	  const price = lines.find((line) => /^\$[\d,]+/.test(line)) ?? null
65	  const title =
66	    lines.find(
67	      (line) =>
68	        line !== price &&
69	        !line.match(/^(Free|Just listed|Yesterday|Today|\d+ miles?)$/i) &&
70	        !line.includes(','),
71	    ) ??
72	    lines[0] ??
73	    null
74	  const location =
75	    lines.find(
76	      (line) =>
77	        line !== price &&
78	        line !== title &&
79	        (line.includes(',') || /\d+\s*miles?\b/i.test(line)),
80	    ) ?? null
81	
82	  return { title, price, location }
83	}

85	async function detectLoginRequired(page: Page): Promise<boolean> {
86	  const url = page.url()
87	
88	  if (url.includes('/login') || url.includes('checkpoint')) {
89	    return true
90	  }
91	
92	  const emailField = page.locator('input[name="email"]')
93	  const passwordField = page.locator('input[name="pass"]')
94	
95	  const hasEmail = await emailField.first().isVisible().catch(() => false)
96	  const hasPassword = await passwordField.first().isVisible().catch(() => false)
97	
98	  return hasEmail && hasPassword
99	}
100	
101	async function pageTextIncludes(page: Page, needle: string): Promise<boolean> {
102	  const lower = needle.toLowerCase()
103	  const content = await page.content().catch(() => '')
104	  if (content.toLowerCase().includes(lower)) {
105	    return true
106	  }
107	  const bodyText = await page.locator('body').innerText().catch(() => '')
108	  return bodyText.toLowerCase().includes(lower)
109	}
110	
111	async function detectCaptcha(page: Page): Promise<boolean> {
112	  const url = page.url().toLowerCase()
113	  if (url.includes('captcha') || url.includes('/checkpoint/')) {
114	    return true
115	  }
116	
117	  const captchaSelectors = [
118	    'iframe[src*="captcha"]',
119	    'iframe[src*="recaptcha"]',
120	    '[id*="captcha" i]',
121	    '[class*="captcha" i]',
122	    '#captcha',
123	  ]
124	
125	  for (const selector of captchaSelectors) {
126	    const visible = await page
127	      .locator(selector)
128	      .first()
129	      .isVisible()
130	      .catch(() => false)
131	    if (visible) return true
132	  }
133	
134	  return (
135	    (await pageTextIncludes(page, 'security check')) ||
136	    (await pageTextIncludes(page, 'confirm you')) ||
137	    (await pageTextIncludes(page, 'captcha'))
138	  )
139	}

141	export type EmptyScrapeDiagnostics = {
142	  capturedAt: string
143	  query: string
144	  location: string
145	  initialUrl: string
146	  finalUrl: string
147	  pageTitle: string
148	  loginFieldsExist: boolean
149	  captchaExists: boolean
150	  marketplaceUnavailable: boolean
151	  somethingWentWrong: boolean
152	  listingAnchorCount: number
153	  screenshotPath: string
154	  htmlPath: string
155	  metaPath: string
156	}
157	
158	const EMPTY_SCRAPE_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), 'storage')
159	const EMPTY_SCREENSHOT_PATH = path.join(EMPTY_SCRAPE_DIR, 'marketplace-empty.png')
160	const EMPTY_HTML_PATH = path.join(EMPTY_SCRAPE_DIR, 'marketplace-empty.html')
161	const EMPTY_META_PATH = path.join(EMPTY_SCRAPE_DIR, 'marketplace-empty.json')
162	
163	async function captureEmptyScrapeDiagnostics(
164	  page: Page,
165	  searchParams: MarketplaceSearchParams,
166	  initialUrl: string,
167	): Promise<EmptyScrapeDiagnostics> {
168	  const finalUrl = page.url()
169	  const pageTitle = await page.title()
170	  const loginFieldsExist = await detectLoginRequired(page)
171	  const captchaExists = await detectCaptcha(page)
172	  const marketplaceUnavailable = await pageTextIncludes(
173	    page,
174	    "Marketplace isn't available",
175	  )
176	  const somethingWentWrong = await pageTextIncludes(page, 'Something went wrong')
177	  const listingAnchorCount = await page
178	    .locator('a[href*="/marketplace/item/"]')
179	    .count()
180	
181	  console.log(`[marketplace-empty] Final URL: ${finalUrl}`)
182	  console.log(`[marketplace-empty] Page title: ${pageTitle}`)
183	  console.log(`[marketplace-empty] Login fields exist: ${loginFieldsExist}`)
184	  console.log(`[marketplace-empty] CAPTCHA exists: ${captchaExists}`)
185	  console.log(
186	    `[marketplace-empty] "Marketplace isn't available" exists: ${marketplaceUnavailable}`,
187	  )
188	  console.log(
189	    `[marketplace-empty] "Something went wrong" exists: ${somethingWentWrong}`,
190	  )
191	  console.log(
192	    `[marketplace-empty] Listing anchors exist: ${listingAnchorCount > 0} (count=${listingAnchorCount})`,
193	  )
194	
195	  fs.mkdirSync(EMPTY_SCRAPE_DIR, { recursive: true })
196	  await page.screenshot({ path: EMPTY_SCREENSHOT_PATH, fullPage: true })
197	  fs.writeFileSync(EMPTY_HTML_PATH, await page.content(), 'utf8')
198	
199	  const diagnostics: EmptyScrapeDiagnostics = {
200	    capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
201	    query: searchParams.query,
202	    location: searchParams.location,
203	    initialUrl,
204	    finalUrl,
205	    pageTitle,
206	    loginFieldsExist,
207	    captchaExists,
208	    marketplaceUnavailable,
209	    somethingWentWrong,
210	    listingAnchorCount,
211	    screenshotPath: EMPTY_SCREENSHOT_PATH,
212	    htmlPath: EMPTY_HTML_PATH,
213	    metaPath: EMPTY_META_PATH,
214	  }
215	
216	  fs.writeFileSync(EMPTY_META_PATH, JSON.stringify(diagnostics, null, 2), 'utf8')
217	
218	  console.log(`[marketplace-empty] Saved screenshot: ${EMPTY_SCREENSHOT_PATH}`)
219	  console.log(`[marketplace-empty] Saved HTML: ${EMPTY_HTML_PATH}`)
220	  console.log(`[marketplace-empty] Saved meta: ${EMPTY_META_PATH}`)
221	  console.log(
222	    '[marketplace-empty] Inspect via GET /debug/marketplace-empty (and /screenshot, /html)',
223	  )
224	
225	  return diagnostics
226	}
227	
228	export function getEmptyScrapeArtifactPaths() {
229	  return {
230	    screenshotPath: EMPTY_SCREENSHOT_PATH,
231	    htmlPath: EMPTY_HTML_PATH,
232	    metaPath: EMPTY_META_PATH,
233	  }
234	}
235	
236	export function readEmptyScrapeMeta(): EmptyScrapeDiagnostics | null {
237	  if (!fs.existsSync(EMPTY_META_PATH)) return null
238	  try {
239	    return JSON.parse(
240	      fs.readFileSync(EMPTY_META_PATH, 'utf8'),
241	    ) as EmptyScrapeDiagnostics
242	  } catch {
243	    return null
244	  }
245	}

247	async function waitForListings(page: Page, timeoutMs: number): Promise<void> {
248	  await page
249	    .waitForSelector('a[href*="/marketplace/item/"]', { timeout: timeoutMs })
250	    .catch(() => undefined)
251	}
252	
253	async function collectListings(
254	  page: Page,
255	  maxListings: number,
256	): Promise<ListingInput[]> {
257	  const anchors = page.locator('a[href*="/marketplace/item/"]')
258	  const total = await anchors.count()
259	  const results: ListingInput[] = []
260	  const seenUrls = new Set<string>()
261	
262	  for (let i = 0; i < total && results.length < maxListings; i++) {
263	    const anchor = anchors.nth(i)
264	    const href = await anchor.getAttribute('href')
265	
266	    if (!href) {
267	      continue
268	    }
269	
270	    const listingUrl = href.startsWith('http')
271	      ? href.split('?')[0]
272	      : `https://www.facebook.com${href.split('?')[0]}`
273	
274	    if (seenUrls.has(listingUrl)) {
275	      continue
276	    }
277	
278	    seenUrls.add(listingUrl)
279	
280	    const text = (await anchor.innerText().catch(() => '')) || ''
281	    const { title, price, location } = parseListingText(text)
282	    const imageUrl =
283	      (await anchor.locator('img').first().getAttribute('src').catch(() => null)) ??
284	      null
285	
286	    results.push({
287	      source: FACEBOOK_MARKETPLACE_SOURCE,
288	      listingUrl,
289	      title,
290	      price,
291	      location,
292	      imageUrl,
293	    })
294	  }
295	
296	  return results
297	}
298	
299	export async function scrapeMarketplaceSearch(
300	  searchParams: MarketplaceSearchParams,
301	  options: ScrapeOptions = {},
302	): Promise<ListingInput[]> {
303	  const {
304	    headless = true,
305	    maxListings = 5,
306	    listingWaitTimeoutMs = 30_000,
307	    onPageReady,
308	  } = options
309	
310	  const searchUrl = buildMarketplaceSearchUrl(searchParams)
311	  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless })
312	
313	  // Default: use anonymous Marketplace scraping.
314	  // If USE_FACEBOOK_AUTH=true, load the saved Facebook session instead.
315	  const rawUseFacebookAuth = process.env.USE_FACEBOOK_AUTH
316	  const useFacebookAuth = rawUseFacebookAuth === 'true'
317	  const stateFileExists = fs.existsSync(FACEBOOK_STORAGE_STATE_PATH)
318	  const loadingAuthenticatedSession = useFacebookAuth && stateFileExists
319	
320	  console.log(`USE_FACEBOOK_AUTH=${rawUseFacebookAuth ?? '(unset)'}`)
321	  console.log(`facebook-state.json exists: ${stateFileExists}`)
322	  console.log(`Loading authenticated session: ${loadingAuthenticatedSession}`)
323	  if (loadingAuthenticatedSession) {
324	    console.log('Creating authenticated Playwright context (storageState will be passed)')
325	  } else {
326	    console.log('Creating anonymous Playwright context')
327	  }
328	
329	  const context = loadingAuthenticatedSession
330	    ? await browser.newContext({ storageState: FACEBOOK_STORAGE_STATE_PATH })
331	    : await browser.newContext()
332	
333	  if (loadingAuthenticatedSession) {
334	    console.log(
335	      `Using authenticated Facebook session from ${FACEBOOK_STORAGE_STATE_PATH}`,
336	    )
337	  } else if (useFacebookAuth && !stateFileExists) {
338	    console.log(
339	      'USE_FACEBOOK_AUTH=true but no storage state found — using anonymous browser session',
340	    )
341	  } else {
342	    console.log('Using anonymous Facebook Marketplace session')
343	  }
344	
345	  const page = await context.newPage()
346	
347	  try {
348	    console.log(`[marketplace] Search query: ${searchParams.query}`)
349	    console.log(`[marketplace] Initial URL: ${searchUrl}`)
350	
351	    await page.goto(searchUrl, {
352	      waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',
353	      timeout: 60_000,
354	    })
355	
356	    const finalUrl = page.url()
357	    const pageTitle = await page.title()
358	    const loginUiDetected = await detectLoginRequired(page)
359	
360	    console.log(`[marketplace] Final URL: ${finalUrl}`)
361	    console.log(`[marketplace] Page title: ${pageTitle}`)
362	    console.log(`[marketplace] Login UI detected: ${loginUiDetected}`)
363	
364	    if (onPageReady) {
365	      await onPageReady(page)
366	    } else if (loginUiDetected) {
367	      console.warn(
368	        'Facebook login UI detected during anonymous scrape. Continuing without waiting for manual login.',
369	      )
370	    }
371	
372	    await waitForListings(page, listingWaitTimeoutMs)
373	
374	    const anchorCount = await page
375	      .locator('a[href*="/marketplace/item/"]')
376	      .count()
377	    console.log(`[marketplace] Listing anchors found: ${anchorCount}`)
378	
379	    // Must await before the finally block runs, otherwise browser.close()
380	    // executes while collectListings() is still using the page.
381	    const listings = await collectListings(page, maxListings)
382	    console.log(`[marketplace] Listings returned: ${listings.length}`)
383	
384	    if (listings.length === 0) {
385	      await captureEmptyScrapeDiagnostics(page, searchParams, searchUrl)
386	    }
387	
388	    return listings
389	  } catch (error) {
390	    throw new ScraperError(
391	      `Failed to scrape Marketplace for query "${searchParams.query}"`,
392	      { cause: error },
393	    )
394	  } finally {
395	    await browser.close()
396	  }
397	}

I added the new test file for `buildMarketplaceSearchUrl` with 12 tests. I haven't run anything: under my role the Tester does that, so `npm --prefix tracker-api test` passing is still unconfirmed.

### Changes Made
- Created `tracker-api/tests/services/facebook-scraper.test.ts`, in a new `tests/services/` folder that mirrors `src/services/` (decision-002).
- I followed the style of `tests/store/searches.test.ts` and mocked `../../src/lib/prisma` before importing the code under test. This keeps the test from needing Prisma or a database if the `store/listings` import is loaded at runtime.
- Each test turns the result into a `URL` and checks `origin`, `pathname` and `searchParams`, so parameter order and encoding don't matter. The tests are inside `describe('buildMarketplaceSearchUrl')`:
  - **Location slug** (3 tests):
    - The origin is `https://www.facebook.com`.
    - `'New York City'` becomes `/marketplace/newyorkcity/search/`.
    - `' Phil  ADELPHIA\t\n'` becomes `/marketplace/philadelphia/search/`.
  - **Search parameters** (4 tests):
    - `query` is passed through, including a query with a space (`'gsxr 1000'`).
    - `exact === 'false'`.
    - `radius === '65'`.
  - **maxPrice** (5 tests):
    - `6500` gives `maxPrice === '6500'`.
    - An `it.each` over `null`, `undefined` and `0` checks `maxPrice` is left out each time.
    - One more case leaves the `maxPrice` key out entirely and checks the same thing.
- I saved one lesson to storage under `lesson/MR-CAP-001`: mock Prisma before importing the scraper, and compare parsed URLs instead of raw strings.

### Files Modified
- `tracker-api/tests/services/facebook-scraper.test.ts` (new; the only file touched)

### Notes
- **Retrieval:** it worked and returned 4 lessons about scraper feasibility, authentication and backend reuse. None of them applied to this task.
- **No source changes:** nothing under `tracker-api/src`, the existing tests or the config was changed.
- **Expected total:** if the existing count really is 15, the full run should show 27 tests (15 + 12). The Tester should confirm the starting count of 15.
- **Negative `maxPrice`:** no test covers it, as the plan specified. The source uses `if (params.maxPrice)`, so a negative value would still be added to the URL.
- **Dependencies:** if `tracker-api/node_modules` is missing, the Tester needs to run `npm --prefix tracker-api ci` before the test run.
